name: Similarity-driven aggregation
summary: Agents relocate when too few neighbours share their type.
effect: Mild individual preference produces large segregated clusters.

name: Activity-induced phase separation (MIPS)
summary: Self-propelled particles slow where crowded (density-dependent motility).
effect: Dense and dilute phases coexist with no attractive force.

name: Turing pattern formation
summary: Reaction-diffusion with a fast inhibitor and slow activator.
effect: A stationary labyrinth at a selected wavelength self-organises from near-uniformity.

name: Territoriality / exclusion
summary: Agents deposit and avoid foreign scent as they move.
effect: Exclusive home ranges with sharp boundaries emerge.

name: Flocking / alignment
summary: Each agent steers toward the mean heading of neighbours.
effect: Global polar order (a moving flock) emerges below a noise threshold.

name: Milling / vortex
summary: Self-propulsion plus attraction-repulsion forces.
effect: A rotating mill (nonzero angular momentum) forms.

name: Lane formation
summary: Two opposing streams of agents avoid collisions.
effect: Counter-flowing lanes self-organise.

name: Self-organized traffic jams
summary: Cars accelerate, brake, and randomly dawdle on a 1-D road.
effect: Stop-and-go jams appear spontaneously above a density.

name: Synchronization
summary: Coupled phase oscillators with a spread of natural frequencies.
effect: Above a critical coupling the population phase-locks.

name: Chimera states
summary: Non-locally coupled identical oscillators.
effect: Coherent and incoherent groups coexist simultaneously.

name: Predator-prey oscillation
summary: Spatial Lotka-Volterra predation on a lattice.
effect: Anti-correlated population cycles with travelling fronts.

name: Cyclic dominance (RPS)
summary: Three species in rock-paper-scissors competition on a lattice.
effect: Self-sustaining spiral waves maintain coexistence.

name: Excitable spiral / target waves
summary: Excitable cells with refractory recovery.
effect: Self-sustaining spiral and target waves propagate.

name: Self-organized criticality
summary: A driven sandpile topples when slope exceeds threshold.
effect: Avalanches follow a scale-free power law without tuning.

name: Persistent propagating computation
summary: Deterministic life-like cellular automaton.
effect: Propagating structures carry and transform information.

name: Associative memory
summary: A symmetric recurrent net relaxes from a corrupted cue.
effect: The network completes the cue to the nearest stored pattern.

name: Collective gradient sensing
summary: Agents with noisy individual sensing follow social cues.
effect: The group climbs a gradient no individual can resolve.

name: Consensus / coarsening
summary: Each agent copies a random neighbour's opinion.
effect: Opinion domains coarsen toward consensus.

name: Emergent leadership
summary: A small informed minority has a preferred direction.
effect: The uninformed majority is steered accurately by a few.

name: Quorum sensing
summary: Agents switch ON when local signal crosses a threshold.
effect: A sharp, hysteretic collective switch at a critical density.

name: Polarization / fragmentation
summary: Bounded-confidence opinion dynamics.
effect: A unimodal population fragments into separated camps.

name: Information cascade / contagion
summary: Susceptible-infected-recovered spread on a lattice.
effect: An epidemic wavefront sweeps the population.

name: Anti-coordination / load balancing
summary: Agents win by choosing the minority side.
effect: Attendance self-balances with sub-random (efficient) variance.

name: Homeostatic regulation
summary: Feedback drives a variable back to its set-point.
effect: The regulated variable rejects perturbations and holds set-point.

name: Canalized restoration / equifinality
summary: Many initial conditions flow down a canalized landscape.
effect: Different starts converge to the same attractor macrostate.

name: Stochastic resonance
summary: A sub-threshold signal plus tuned noise in a bistable unit.
effect: Optimal noise maximises signal detection (inverted-U).

name: Spatial reciprocity
summary: Cooperators and defectors play neighbours on a lattice.
effect: Cooperation survives by forming spatial clusters.

name: Wealth condensation
summary: Agents repeatedly trade a random fraction of wealth.
effect: Wealth spontaneously condenses to extreme inequality.

name: Trail / network formation
summary: Agents reinforce and evaporate trails between nodes.
effect: An efficient near-minimal transport network emerges.

name: Autopoiesis / boundary formation
summary: Catalysis links substrate particles into a membrane that decays.
effect: A self-maintaining closed boundary forms and persists.

name: Delayed gratification
summary: Agents forgo immediate reward for larger later payoff.
effect: Per-agent restraint carries information beyond the policy label.

detector.note: Validated via a separate multi-run non-redundancy test (no Phase-2a battery panel).

name: Emergent specialization
summary: Response-threshold agents take tasks they sense most.
effect: Division of labour emerges as roles differentiate.
